posts.text: This is like a hellish Groundhog Day

friday was my last day at @initia.

im grateful to have had the opportunity to work alongside such a talented team, and to everyone who read, challenged, and supported the marketing we made over the past year and a half.

Like many of you, my faith in this industry has been https://t.co/QOt6FAZlxm
